title: AERO9500 Report Marking Rubric (Assignment Part 2)

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Addresses all requirements to a high standard. Detailed descriptions and discussions included, with references to literature as appropriate.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Addresses some requirements. Descriptions may lack specific details and/or referencing incomplete.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Many or all requirements not addressed. Poor descriptions or lack of appropriate referencing.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Demonstrates high-level understanding of design procedure. Design clearly addresses mission and course concepts. All major requirements addressed and well supported with quality evidence e.g. screenshots, software files, hand calcs, literature. Content comprehensive, accurate, persuasive.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Demonstrates adequate understanding of design procedure. Design may be inconsistent regarding purpose and clarity or feature errors. Major requirements addressed but may lack detail or not well supported with evidence. Content may not be comprehensive or persuasive.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Demonstrates minimal understanding of design procedure. Major requirements not addressed and/or lack evidence. Content incomplete or not persuasive.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Detailed and appropriate conclusions reached from evidence provided in report.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Some conclusions reached but may be generic or lack specific detail.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: No actual or useful conclusions reached.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Clear logical engineering report structure. Easy to read: well-written, good spelling, grammar, appropriate style. Consistent formatting. Executive summary/abstract provides concise overview. Graphical/tablular data appropriate, clear, consistent. References in-text match reference list and properly cited.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Not at professional level but uses headings/subheadings. May be difficult to read, writing just ok, spelling/grammar flaws, language style not quite appropriate. Figures/tables labelled but formatting unclear/inconsistent, reader may lose context. References mostly match list and mostly cited correctly.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Poorly structured, not coherent, shows lack of understanding of section purpose. Hard to read: poor writing, many spelling/grammar mistakes, possibly inappropriate informal style. Presentation poor impedes reading. Examples: inconsistent formatting, unlabelled figures/tables. References not cited or cited inconsistently.

notes: Assignment Part 2 is 25% of course grade. Performance levels use common 0-10 band scale; weighting determines contribution to total (total = 10 marks scaled to 100%). Criteria details condensed from original.
